dedupe_keys.name: spectral lighting reference office and factory hall models

description: These reference models describe an office and a factory hall for full-spectral daylight and electric-lighting simulation. University of Innsbruck researchers and collaborators provide Rhino geometry, measured or sourced spectral material properties, lamp spectra, glazing and blind BSDFs, and weather inputs. The office represents Room 518 in Innsbruck; the hall follows a standard reference geometry. Zenodo supplies separate model, Radiance-implementation and OWL-implementation archives free under CC BY 4.0. The Radiance archive is approximately 6.3 gigabytes and includes example results. Coverage is two static scenes, with no established calendar observation series. Idealised geometry, assumed material spectra and software-specific setup are limitations for transfer to another building. Modellers could compare spectral metrics, lighting controls or simulation implementations. platform-ladybug-tools and model-energyplus provide related building-analysis environments, without a verified direct import. No archive was downloaded, no implementation executed and no agreement between the two tools was independently tested.
